name: com.riseon.outline2d
description: Outline the merged silhouette of a group of renderers (sprites, meshes such as Spine skeletons) or UI Graphics, expanded exactly like Select > Modify > Expand, over an optional soft drop shadow, with a fixed texel budget and a performance profile: capture on demand or at an interval, exact on worker threads or fast on the GPU, asynchronous or in the same frame
